set.name: verinoda_user_tr
set.description: PATCHED COPY for the 2026-10-02 rerun: u01.detect's text alternative 'copies.detect' removed (it occurs nowhere in the pinned corpus, so the harness refuses the set as gold_invalid); everything else unchanged. Verinoda's own source at commit 3bd1b94 (the verinoda package without the vendored project_index and data files): 12 Turkish questions a user of Verinoda asks about Verinoda itself - how copies are found, how to open the graph, how the page follows the index, where notes live, what impact counts, how machine paths leave an export, why graph.html is gone, when a sub-question is met, why update is slow, how the UI server is protected, what portable ids are for, how --watch notices edits.
set.gold_verified_by: Gold written by reading the code at 3bd1b94; every fact's line was found by its source.contains text in `git show` of that commit, and is re-checked against the benchmark copy before scoring (metrics.validate_gold).

provenance.questions_written_by: u02 is a user's own question from a session (2026-09-24), as typed; the other 11 were written in the same style by the agent that built these features, on 2026-09-25
provenance.gold_written_by: the same agent, by reading the code at the pinned commit
provenance.caveat: not a log of real users' questions (Verinoda keeps none); written after the 2026-09-25 retrieval and analysis changes by their author, so treat results as in-sample

verinoda_analyze.budget: config defaults (60 s, 40 tool calls, 6000 tokens)

llm.status: not measured: llm='none' (use --llm anthropic with ANTHROPIC_API_KEY set)

raw.note: no index; every query greps and reads the working tree

verinoda.what: workflow.scan = Graphify-derived AST index (in-process) + snapshot (file hashes) + stale-claim check; warm = same tree again with the AST cache present
